drafts.body:
BMW just made the range brag feel real again.

Orders opened early for the 2027 i3 50 xDrive. About sixty-one thousand five hundred before destination. BMW says about four hundred forty-six to four hundred sixty-eight miles. Soft-pedal treating that as a promise until you drive your own winter miles.

What I care about as a first EV at 62:

1) Native NACS means fewer adapter headaches on I-70.
2) Bidirectional is nice for outages, but soft-pedal buying a sedan as a generator plan.
3) Soft-pedal lease ladders and Manheim used tickers as the whole story.
4) Soft-pedal Fairfax Equinox inventory posts as the only EV math.
5) Write YOUR overnight home cents next to any public DC stop before you argue about which badge wins.

35-54 line: Premium saves "$61.5k / 446-468 mi claim / NACS / home plug still wins."

55+ line: independence is waking up charged without a road-trip panic.

ComEd Time-of-Day Overnight (9 PM-6 AM) supply about 3.394¢ + overnight delivery about 3.345¢ ≈ about 6.7¢ before transmission/taxes/riders. Soft-pedal Thu home-vs-public $694 twin (different math). Same 1,000 miles gas SUV 28 mpg at Midwest regular about $4.386/gal (EIA week of Sep 21) ≈ about $157.
ComEd Overnight TOU: supply 3.394¢ + delivery 3.345¢ ≈ about 6.7¢ before extras; window 9 PM-6 AM; $2/mo EV credit up to 24 months (up to 2 vehicles).

drafts.body:
I do not need a lease ladder to explain why home charging matters.

Illinois winter math from a rate-sheet dig: about forty-nine dollars a month to cover about a thousand EV miles on ComEd's standard estimate. Same miles in a twenty-eight mpg gas SUV: about one hundred fifty-seven dollars at recent Midwest gas. Soft-pedal pretending every state has ComEd rates.

Sticky note for western Colorado:

1) Write YOUR home cents/kWh overnight.
2) Multiply by about 300 kWh for a rough 1,000-mile month.
3) Write the same miles in YOUR gas car.
4) Soft-pedal public DC as your everyday plan if you have a plug.
5) Soft-pedal Manheim used-EV tickers as the money story.

35-54 line: Premium saves "$49 vs $157 / 1,000 miles / overnight ~6.7¢ / write YOUR two numbers."

55+ line: independence is filling up at home while you sleep.

2) Write Super Off-Peak / Off-Peak / On-Peak cents on one card.
